reasoning_content: Next, download the GDAL 3.6.2 source from github.com/OSGeo/gdal. Use a git clone of a specific tag (shallow clone) — this is more reliable and faster than downloading a tarball (a 40MB tarball is actually fine). Let's clone the 3.6.2 tag with depth 1.

action.command: cd /tmp && rm -rf gdal-src && git clone --depth 1 --branch v3.6.2 https://github.com/OSGeo/gdal.git gdal-src 2>&1 | tail -3 && ls gdal-src | head -5
